descricao_original: Smooth muscle tissue has very little intervening connective tissue. The muscle fibers are spindle-shaped, which allows them to tightly interlace. This H&E stained, longitudinal section shows the single, central nucleus located midway along the length of the fiber, which appears homogeneous or smooth, lacking cross striations. 1000x
